result.summary: Several visual and content bugs: a raw localization key is shown as a section title, restaurant names and category chips are clipped, and the last card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: Section heading displays the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so keys never render in the UI.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is clipped: restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' and part of the image is off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Give cards a consistent width, enable horizontal scrolling with peek/padding, or wrap/truncate names with ellipsis so content stays fully visible.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are missing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right; the last chip is only partially visible with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a fade or peek of the next chip so users can see that the list is scrollable.
